skill.displayName: 小红书操作全集 Xiaohongshu All In One 基于api接口稳定快速

llm.summary: This skill largely does what it says, but it can run unverified downloaded binaries, store account cookies in plaintext, and perform real account/platform actions with limited safeguards.

dimensions.detail: Network and local command use are purpose-aligned, but the authority is broad relative to safeguards: the base URL can be changed, cookie files are kept in the working directory, and service restart can kill whatever owns the configured port.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is via uv/PyPI or source, then the CLI downloads the latest MCP release assets from GitHub, extracts archives into the working directory, marks files executable, and starts the resulting native binary without pinned versions, checksums, signatures, or archive path validation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill gives broad activation and command guidance without strong confirmation requirements for externally visible posts/comments, logout, account removal/switching, cookie import/export, binary execution, or process termination.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill starts a detached background MCP process and persists reusable session cookies in user_cookies.json and cookies.json as plaintext with default filesystem permissions; it does not attempt privilege escalation or install system services.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated Xiaohongshu account, publishing, feed, user, and MCP-service management purpose matches most code paths, but the implementation includes high-impact capabilities: publishing content, commenting, logout/cookie deletion, account switching, and local service lifecycle control.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review carefully before installing. Use only in a dedicated directory and preferably a test account, do not store or share the cookie JSON files casually, avoid running it with elevated privileges, and treat MCP download/start/restart as execution of unverified third-party native code. Confirm the target account and content before any publish, comment, logout, or account-switch action.
llm.findings:
[T03] expected: MCP server download/start is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but the artifact confirms mutable latest GitHub release binaries are downloaded and executed without integrity verification, making this a material Review concern.
[T09] unexpected: The artifact confirms unsafe archive extractall usage and plaintext storage of reusable account cookies; these are not necessary consequences of the stated purpose and are under-protected.
[T05] expected: Service stop/restart is expected for MCP management, but the code can SIGKILL/taskkill a PID based on port ownership or broad process-name matching without verifying it is the managed service.
[AST5] expected: Executing the MCP server binary is expected for service management, but os.execv is used after the unverified download/extraction path, so the scanner concern is supported in context.
[SQP-2] expected: Cookie handling, logout, publishing, and comments are core features, but documentation and runtime flows provide limited warnings or confirmation despite credential and externally visible account impact.
[TP4] unexpected: The claimed like/favorite operations appear in SKILL.md, while the CLI only implements comment and reply interactions; this is a documentation mismatch, not evidence of malicious behavior.
